summary: OPERATOR STANDING INSTRUCTION, 2026-09-17, verbatim: 'if there is ever any spot that you are unsure about, i would really like you to go into my browser and manually check the spot. this should help you in your task to build a baseline, and even just checking a small number of hands (could be anything from 10 to 1000) will really help you get a feel for that baseline so please go into my gto frequently to check hands that the bot is playing and keep training it.' Build the harness this needs: a command that samples N decisions the bot faced in a scoreboard or arena run (seat count, positions, stacks, action so far, board, hole cards, the bot's chosen action and the search's frequencies over the fchpa menu) and prints each in a form the stoker can enter into GTO Wizard by hand; a record file (research/results/theory_agreement/) where the stoker writes the reference's action and frequencies per spot; and a summary that reports the agreement rate with an interval, split preflop/postflop. The stoker (the only agent with browser tools) does the entering in the operator's signed-in Chrome; workers cannot. Disagreements feed Stage 5's baseline tuning; nothing is copied out of GTO Wizard into the bot's tables. This is the measurement behind the operator's bar 'somewhat similar to theory' OPERATOR ADDED, 2026-09-17, verbatim: '10 to 1000 isnt a restriction of any kind, feel free to use it as much as you want. i want our solver to be as good as we can.' No cap on reference checks.
